metadata.confidence_constraint: risk and evidence confidence must be numbers in inclusive range 0.0 to 1.0

evidence_object_schema.case_id: non-empty string; must equal bundle case_id
evidence_object_schema.risk_code: one of the eight active risk codes assessed in risks[]
evidence_object_schema.exact_text: non-empty verbatim text copied from the prospectus
evidence_object_schema.evidence_reason: non-empty explanation of how the text supports the risk assessment
